scope: paired policy replay on shared actual ROS/MoveIt evaluations, followed by nominal Gazebo execution and separate held-out boundary rejection; NOT commissioning authorization or a manual engineering user study
candidate_generation: six deterministic space-spreading coarse grid candidates then two local refinements around the best nominal joint margin; identical observed pool for all policies
nominal_ranking: all nominal hard gates first, then descending minimum joint limit margin, ascending relocation, lexicographic x/y/yaw
robust_ranking: existing Engine hard feasibility and robustness gates, then existing deterministic rank_key
manual_baseline: No human manual trial supplied. Fixed original configuration is a labelled proxy only; human task time, approval and engineering success are unavailable, not zero.
integrity: Input jobs/tolerances/distributions/amplitudes unchanged. Only the explicit search/held-out seed blocks above are applied to experiment copies. Full evidence and all failures retained. No physical specifications or statistical significance claimed.
execution: Serialized virtual-only nominal test harness, not a commissioning gate bypass: no recommendation/approval is fabricated. Nominal execution does not qualify a job as robust.
stopping: Mandatory boundary failures reject robust policy; unexecuted MC remains missing. No threshold relaxation. Scenario sets frozen before first run. Never reuse comparison results as final held-out authorization.
